our_interpretation: The testable commitment is that widespread customer purchases generating substantial robot data would require a multiyear wait from October 2022.
Years away expresses a minimum waiting expectation, not a deadline by which purchases must occur. I do not impose the screens' proposed two-year deadline.
The optimistic scenario is emphasis, not a separately observable antecedent.
The price identifies the proposed product and purchase scenario; this is not a claim about Tesla's financial accounts.
criteria.support_condition: Dated commercial and deployment records establish that the specified customer-purchase and data-collection transition took years rather than months.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified widespread customer purchases of roughly $20,000 Optimus robots generated substantial operational data within months of the post, clearly before a multiyear wait.
